articles.description:
赫海威2026年2月10日周一，日本首相高市早苗在东京举行的记者会上。 Pool photo by Franck Robichon
Last summer, Japan’s long-dominant political force, the Liberal Democratic Party, faced a crisis. Plagued by scandal, it had suffered a series of electoral defeats so devastating that its leader, Japan’s prime minister, was forced to resign.
去年夏天，日本长期执政的政治力量自民党陷入危机。受丑闻困扰，该党接连遭遇毁灭性的选举失利，时任党魁兼日本首相被迫辞职。
Then, just as the political obituaries were being written, the Liberal Democrats found a savior: Sanae Takaichi, a veteran conservative lawmaker who in October became the first woman to serve as Japan’s prime minister.
就在政治讣告即将写成之际，该党迎来了救星：资深保守派议员高市早苗。她于去年10月成为日本首位女性首相。
Ms. Takaichi, 64, spoke plainly and energetically — sometimes with Trumpian flourishes — about immigration, taxes and the high cost of living. She had a knack fo…
articles.title: 从危机中挽救自民党，高市早苗是如何做到的

articles.description:
DAVID PIERSON2026年2月10日2020年，黎智英在香港家中。 Lam Yik Fei for The New York Times
For decades, Jimmy Lai, the media mogul, used his wealth and his newsroom in Hong Kong to criticize Beijing’s authoritarian excesses and give voice to those who hoped for democracy in China.
几十年来，媒体大亨黎智英一直利用自己的财富以及在香港掌控的新闻机构批评北京的威权暴行，并为那些希望中国实现民主的人士发声。
On Monday, as a court in Hong Kong sentenced him to 20 years in prison, the city made clear that defiance now carries the same price as it does across the border.
周一，香港一家法院判处他20年监禁，这座城市清楚地表明，如今在这里违抗政府所要付出的代价，已与中国内地别无二致。
The landmark ruling completes a yearslong effort by Beijing to dismantle the influence of a self-proclaimed “troublemaker” whom it blamed for masterminding Hong Kong’s pro-democracy protests nearly seven years ago. Critics say Beijing declared Mr. Lai g…
articles.title: 黎智英获刑20年，北京加速侵蚀香港自由

MAUREEN DOWD2026年2月9日 Kenny Holston/The New York Times
It seems etymologically, metaphysically, geologically and ethically impossible that President Trump could reach a new low. But he has.
纵究词源学、形而上学、地质学与伦理学，特朗普总统似乎不可能再刷新下限。但他确实做到了。

The man who pushed the despicable “birther” conspiracy…

articles.description:
黄瑞黎2026年2月9日保守派泰自豪党阿努廷·参威拉恭周日在曼谷。 Lauren Decicca/Getty Images
It boiled down to a choice between two starkly different visions of Thailand’s future: one dominated by nationalism, respect for the monarchy and defense of the status quo, the other by promises of change and true democracy.
这场选举归根结底是在两种截然不同的泰国未来愿景之间作出抉择：一种以民族主义、尊崇君主制和维护现状为主导，另一种则承诺变革与真正的民主。

郭莉莉2026年2月9日2020年的黎智英。 Anthony Kwan/Getty Images
Jimmy Lai’s 20-year prison sentence, the heaviest penalty handed down for a national security offense in Hong Kong so far, aligns with how the Chinese Communist Party has punished wealthy entrepreneurs and influential academics in the mainland for challenging the state.
黎智英被判20年监禁，这是香港迄今对违反国家安全罪判处的最重刑罚，与中共在大陆惩处挑战国家权威的富裕企业家和知名学者的方式如出一辙。
Xi Jinping, the most powerful Chinese leader in decades, has waged a far-reaching crackdown on any vestiges of dissent. 作为数十年来中国最有权势的领导人，习近平对任何残存的异议展展开了范围广泛的打压，打击对象不仅包括人权活动人士，更波及商业巨头、知识分子及党内精英，其中一些人被判处近20年监禁。
Here is how Mr. Lai’…

articles.description:
赫海威, RIVER AKIRA DAVIS, KIUKO NOTOYA, HISAKO UENO2026年2月9日在周日举行的提前选举中，日本首相高市早苗因其经济政策以及对移民和中国的强硬立场获得了压倒性的支持。 Pool photo by Kim Kyung-Hoon
Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi of Japan made a big gamble on Sunday, holding a snap election only 110 days after she became the first woman to serve as the country’s prime minister. 秘鲁总统被秘密录音或者偷拍并不是什么新鲜事。因腐败指控而导致的弹劾同样屡见不鲜。过去十年间，秘鲁已经更换了七位总统，没有一位任期超过三年，其中一位甚至上台不到一周即宣告辞职。
The country’s current president, José Jerí, 39, who presided over the impeachment of his predecessor and who was then installed in her place last October, could join that list.
现任总统何塞·耶里现年39岁，他曾主持对前任总统的弹劾，随后于去年10月接替了这一职位，而如今，他也可能与前任们面临同样的命运。

一年前，也是在一系列似乎无穷无尽的新闻周期开始之前，唐纳德·特朗普重返华盛顿。

AMY QIN2026年1月20日威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校有大约8000名来自国外的学生，占其总在校生人数的15%。 
One of the first signs of trouble came last spring, when the Trump administration abruptly moved to deport scores of international students, including a handful at the University of Wisconsin-Madison.
麻烦的最初迹象之一出现在去年春天，当时特朗普政府突然行动，将数十名国际学生驱逐出境，其中包括威斯康辛大学麦迪逊分校的几名学生。
